title: 🏙️ Welcome to COSY Town
description: Arrive in COSY Town and complete your first journey with James York.

title: 🤝 First Introductions
description: Introduce yourself and say your name to the receptionist.

title: 🔑 Key Holder
description: Pick up your apartment key from the reception desk.

title: 🏡 Home Sweet Home
description: Unlock and enter your new apartment to complete Chapter 1.

title: 👣 First Steps
description: Complete Chapter 1 end-to-end: introduce yourself, pick up your key, and unlock your apartment.

title: 🏠 Apartment Explorer
description: Explore all five rooms in your apartment.

title: 🔍 Object Finder
description: Find and interact with objects in every room.

title: 🧹 Home Organizer
description: Help James organize the apartment furniture.

title: 🪑 Furniture Master
description: Master all furniture, color, and number vocabulary in Chapter 2.

title: 🏠 Master of the House
description: Explore every room, organize furniture with James, and complete Chapter 2 end-to-end.

title: 🌅 Early Bird
description: Complete your full morning routine from bedroom to kitchen.

title: 📅 Schedule Tracker
description: Follow a daily schedule across town and tell the time.

title: 🚌 Habit Master
description: Master routine verbs, time, and adverbs of frequency in Chapter 3.

title: ⏰ Early Riser
description: Complete the full morning routine in order: wake up, wash, eat, dress, and leave.

title: 🧭 Master Navigator
description: Give directions using imperatives and prepositions to unlock the interactive City Map.

title: 🛍️ Master Shopper
description: Complete your shopping list across shops, master asking prices and quantifiers, and complete Chapter 5.

title: 👨‍🍳 Culinary Master
description: Order food and drinks using polite forms, serve customers as a waiter, unlock culinary recipes, and complete Chapter 6.

title: 🦋 Social Butterfly
description: Meet neighbours Clara & Leo, build friendship levels with Ella & Anna, master Present Continuous, and complete Chapter 7.
